query: SELECT a.product_id, a.target_inventory, a.job_id, COALESCE(p.title, '') AS "title!", MAX(i.settled_at) AS "settled_at!" FROM auto_publish_run a JOIN job_item i ON i.org_id = a.org_id AND i.job_id = a.job_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.org_id = a.org_id AND p.id = a.product_id WHERE a.org_id = $1 GROUP BY a.product_id, a.target_inventory, a.job_id, p.title HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settled_at IS NULL) = 0 AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR MAX(i.settled_at) < $2) ORDER BY MAX(i.settled_at) DESC LIMIT $3
